text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — I'm sketching a tight fieldwork orchestration for SOC2 next quarter. Need short commits from owners for three lanes: KMS attestation, audit-log retention proof, and private deploy smoke. Can people call dibs? :mag:
Sam Ortiz: I can take KMS attestation. I'll need eng-infra to confirm HSM cert rotation windows and a short runbook for the attestation steps. ETA: draft by Tue.
Liam Chen: Heads up — pager rotation overlaps with Tue afternoon. If Sam needs any live cert push, I can carve out a 2hr window Wed morning. Prefer small, scriptable ops not manual SSH.
Olga Petrova: I'll own audit-log retention proof. Plan is to run a backfill verification and retention check against S3 lifecycle + search indexes. Will post checklist by EOD.
Maya Patel: thanks all. For private deploy smoke I can pair with Helen for the network/KMS config verification — Helen? :slightly_smiling_face:
Helen Park: I can do private deploy smoke. Need a quick PR review on the ingest test that asserts log headers and envelope encryption metadata. Pinged @sam for review.
Sam Ortiz: ack — will review the PR tonight. Also, small ask: Sam -> eng-infra, can we get a read-only HSM cert export for the test environment? If not exportable, a test signing endpoint will do.
Liam Chen: FYI we have a maintenance window 03/08 02:00-04:00 UTC. Recommend we avoid attestation steps during that slot. I'll update calendar.
Olga Petrova: schedule snippet I'm proposing:
```
Week 1: preflight checklists posted
Week 2: dry-run (non-prod) — KMS attestation smoke + audit-log backfill verify
Week 3: fieldwork window — production snapshots and evidence capture
Week 4: remediation and final artifacts
```
Maya Patel: looks good. Quick dependency table (short):
- KMS attestation: depends on eng-infra for cert window + Sam for scripts
- Audit-log proof: depends on logging team for index snapshots + Olga for verification
- Private deploy smoke: depends on infra network ACLs + Helen for PRs
Helen Park: small add — we need one more reviewer for the ingress test to avoid blocking CI. Recommend @Liam since he's free Wed AM.
Liam Chen: happy to review the ingest test. Ping me when PR is up.
AuditBot: [automated] New compliance milestone created: "SOC2 fieldwork orchestration" — owners: Maya, Sam, Olga, Helen. Follow-up reminders scheduled.
Maya Patel: next steps: owners post a 1-paragraph plan in the milestone doc by Tue COB, call out any blockers. I'll follow up Thurs for alignment. :calendar:
Sam Ortiz: I'll post mine and link the attestation script sketch.
Olga Petrova: posting checklist tonight. If anyone wants to pair on the backfill tool, DM me.
Helen Park: will open the PR in the morning and tag reviewers.
Maya Patel: great — thanks team. If anything changes ping here, otherwise I'll close the loop after Thurs alignment.
